notes.title: 🌊 Devlog Update: Social Fishing Adventures! 🎣
notes.content:
Hello, cozy fishing fans! 🐟

We’re excited to share some progress on our upcoming social fishing game. The team has been hard at work designing the lobby UI and polishing some of the game’s main mechanics, so here’s a sneak peek at what’s to come!

Some of the work still need lot of work:

[previewyoutube=EJFJYaUSgsE;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=Oj14AjCv8yg;full][/previewyoutube]


🏡 Your Cozy Lobby
Your lobby will be much more than just a place to hang out! It’s your personal hub, where you can:

[list]
[*] Show off your collection: Display the amazing fish, bugs, and pets you’ve discovered on your adventures.
[*] Fish and harvest resources: Yes, you can even cast your line right in your lobby or harvest valuable materials to help you progress!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313411/38ac235f84a053d0e5a5992c5dbf8771213a421a.png[/img]


💰 Level Up Your Gear
Harvested goods and caught fish can be sold to upgrade your tools, like:
[list]
[*] A better fishing rod that helps you reel in fish faster.
[*] Other tools to improve your adventures (more on this in future updates 😉).
[/list]


🎨 What’s Next?
We’re putting the finishing touches on the UI design, ensuring everything feels intuitive and cozy. Expect a blend of fun mechanics with plenty of charm to make your fishing journey relaxing yet rewarding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313411/ef722c23355efb48b87dab0c1b791e26724a7d47.png[/img]

Thank you for your support as we reel in more exciting features. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy fishing! 🎣🐾
